title: Progress
subtitle: Daily site records, verified physical progress and performance.

workPackages.label: Create work packages
workPackages.description: Break the scope into control units, each with an owner and a progress weight.

allocate.label: Allocate BOQ items
allocate.description: Link each work package to the BOQ items it covers, so progress can roll up.

baseline.label: Set the planned baseline
baseline.description: Optional — gives the progress curve a real planned line instead of an estimate.

report.title: Daily progress report
report.emptyHint: Record the first daily report to start capturing site progress.

returnReason.label: Reason for return
returnReason.required: Enter a reason for the return

report.draftOnlyHint: Measurements can only be added while the report is a draft.
report.approvedHint: This report is approved and its measurements are now verified progress.
report.approveConfirmBody: Its measurements become verified progress and the report becomes read-only.
report.returnConfirmBody: The report goes back to the author to correct.
report.selfApprovalWarning: You prepared this report. Approving your own report may need a second reviewer.

measurement.title: Measurements
measurement.leafOnlyHint: Measure against a BOQ item (leaf), not a section.
measurement.empty: No measurements recorded on this report.
measurement.quantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.hint: Photos or short videos of the day's work. A photo shows work happened, not the exact quantity.
evidence.notReady: The file is still uploading. Try again once it finishes.
evidence.dropHint: Drag photos or videos here, or
evidence.wrongType: Only photos and videos can be attached.

verified.title: Verified progress
verified.subtitle: Physical progress per BOQ item, from approved daily reports only.
verified.empty: No verified progress yet. Approve a daily report to see progress here.

curve.title: Progress curve
curve.ariaSummary: Progress curve over {points, plural, one {# period} other {# periods}}. Latest planned {planned}, latest actual physical {physical}.
curve.insufficient: The progress curve begins once progress is recorded.
curve.provisionalNote: The planned line is an estimate until a baseline is set in Plan & Setup.

capture.alreadyRecorded: A snapshot is already recorded for this date.
capture.failed: Could not record the snapshot. Try again.

comparison.title: Period comparison
comparison.insufficient: Comparison appears once two periods have been recorded.

workPackage.title: Work packages
workPackage.subtitle: Control units that carry a responsible owner and a progress weight.
workPackage.emptyHint: Create work packages and allocate BOQ items to roll progress up to a project figure.

form.name: Name
form.weightHint: Fraction of the project (0–1). All work-package weights should total 100%.

allocate.title: Allocate BOQ item
allocate.leafOnly: Only BOQ items (leaves) can be allocated.
allocate.noBaseline: Baseline the BOQ before allocating items.

rollup.title: Project physical progress
rollup.weightsIncomplete: Work-package weights total {total} — the project figure is understated until they reach 100%.
rollup.unavailable: Add work packages with weights to see a project figure.

baseline.title: Planned baseline
baseline.subtitle: The planned progress curve the S-curve compares actuals against. Without one, the planned line is only an estimate.
baseline.noDates: Set the project start and end dates to generate a linear baseline.
baseline.empty: Add points, or start from a generator above.
baseline.errorRange: Each cumulative % must be between 0 and 100.
baseline.errorOrder: Cumulative % cannot go backwards over time.

signal.title: Physical vs financial
signal.costAheadHint: Spending is running ahead of physical progress — investigate the variance.
signal.progressAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of recorded cost.
signal.alignedHint: Physical progress and cost are broadly aligned.
signal.insufficientHint: There is no forecast cost yet, so no comparison can be made.

collectionSignal.title: Collection vs progress
collectionSignal.alignedHint: Collection and physical progress are broadly aligned.
collectionSignal.cashAheadHint: Collection is running ahead of physical progress — the client is financing the work; watch advance exposure.
collectionSignal.workAheadHint: Physical progress is ahead of collection — ACCO is financing the client; chase certification and billing.
collectionSignal.insufficientHint: There is no contract value yet, so no comparison can be made.

programme.title: Milestones
programme.subtitle: Programme delivery milestones — construction stages with baseline dates. Verify a stage when it is complete; a verified milestone is the billing evidence for a payment-schedule installment.

states.emptyHint: Add the project's programme delivery stages with their baseline dates.

variance.early: {n, plural, one {# day early} other {# days early}}
variance.late: {n, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}

verify.title: Verify {name}
verify.hint: Confirm the stage is complete and record the date it actually finished. This becomes billing evidence for any linked payment installment.

activity.title: Activities
activity.subtitle: The work breakdown under each package — planned dates and milestones. Dependencies are deliberately out of scope.
activity.noWorkPackages: Create work packages in Plan & Setup first, then break each into activities.
activity.dateOrder: End date must be on or after the start date.
